title: Installation registered (POST /api/installations, 201)
description: Reader: OpenPairings, which stores the key and sends it as its Bearer credential from then on. Cache-Control: no-store; the key exists nowhere else (the server keeps a digest). Refusals: 403 address_blocked; 429 rate_limited (per address or /64, and per server, each per 24 h); 503 registration_closed.

installation_id.description: The installation's id: in_ and 10 characters (7 random bytes, base64url). OpenPairings stores it as text.

key.description: The installation key: orik_ and 43 characters (32 random bytes, base64url, no padding).
